mgmt_bio.text: Stephen J. Hemsley, known as Steve, has served as chief executive officer of UnitedHealth Group since May 2025 and as chair of its board of directors since September 2017, having been a board member since 2000. He previously served as the company's CEO from 2006 to 2017, after joining as chief operating officer in 1997 and becoming president in 1999. Before UnitedHealth Group, he was managing partner in strategy and planning and chief financial officer at Arthur Andersen, and he graduated from Fordham University in 1974. His return was announced on May 13, 2025, effective immediately, after Andrew Witty stepped down for personal reasons, with Witty continuing as a senior adviser and the company suspending its 2025 outlook as medical costs ran higher than anticipated.
